title: pendingIntent()'s Intent carries the three new extras
description: Completes the extras this Intent puts, matching the new EXTRA_* constants (task-002) and the new schedule()/pendingIntent() parameters.
acceptance_criteria: The existing putExtra(EXTRA_TEXT, text) line is unchanged

Three new lines immediately follow it inside the same .apply block: putExtra(EXTRA_PROFILE_ID, profileId), putExtra(EXTRA_MEDICATION_ID, medicationId), putExtra(EXTRA_DEFAULT_DOSE_AMOUNT, defaultDoseAmount)
exact_code:
putExtra(EXTRA_TEXT, text)
            putExtra(EXTRA_PROFILE_ID, profileId)
            putExtra(EXTRA_MEDICATION_ID, medicationId)
            putExtra(EXTRA_DEFAULT_DOSE_AMOUNT, defaultDoseAmount)
